card.name: Spaces inside dosing-table numbers
card.fires_on: The space or small separator right after a number or unit in dose-by-body-size tables, just before the next number or a unit like 2 in m 2. It also fires on similar spots in numeric ranges and sizes.

modes.label: Body surface area tables
modes.description: The gap after m in a body-surface-area range, before the superscript 2.

modes.label: Tablet combinations and ranges
modes.description: The space after a plus sign or 'to' in a dose combination or numeric range, before the next number.
modes.example: .69 m 2 450 mg twice daily 3 x 150 mg 1 x 200 mg +<< >>1 x 250 mg
